name: ui8kit
description: ui8kit monorepo (UI8Kit 3 primitives in packages/kit via the ui8kit CLI): xgen (the generation layer: specs, schemas, fixtures and the generator), generated packages for Svelte, React, Vue and Solid (and the server templates Go templ, Twig, Jinja2 and Latte), one shared app package, and one host app per runtime that serves every screen spec by name. Bun workspaces.

scripts.check: node packages/tooling/bin/vendor-guard.mjs && node packages/tooling/bin/kit-check.mjs && bun run compose:check && bun run gates:source && bun xgen/skins/skins.ts build --check && bun xgen/cli/src/cli.ts check
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run codex:validate && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.build:hosts: bun run --cwd apps/host-svelte build && bun run --cwd apps/host-react build && bun run --cwd apps/host-vue build && bun run --cwd apps/host-solid build
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:xgen && bun run --filter "@ui8kit/svelte-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/react-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/vue-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/solid-ui" --filter "@ui8kit/app-shared" --filter "host-*" --filter "discovery" --filter "@ui8kit/panorama" --filter "@ui8kit/taste-data" --filter "@ui8kit/taste-screens" --filter "magazine" --parallel check && bun run --cwd packages/kit-compose typecheck
scripts.check:all: bun run build && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run build:hosts && bun run test && bun run lint:px && bun run e2e
scripts.gates:source: node packages/ui-gates/bin/ui-gates.mjs source packages/kit-compose/react packages/kit-compose/svelte packages/kit-compose/vue packages/kit-compose/solid packages/kit-compose/jinja2 packages/kit-compose/twig packages/kit-compose/latte packages/kit-compose/templ/src
